reporting_choice: Historical saved numerical results are preserved transparently; the revised repository implements mask-aware scoring and focused regression tests, but no full numerical rerun is claimed.

current_code.masking: semantic_score, band_gap_score, density_score, and stability_score use explicit availability masks; void_fraction/porosity is unavailable and excluded from active numerical ranking
current_code.balance_score: 1 minus root-mean-square dispersion over observed active objectives, clipped to [0, 1]
